actual_scope: Controller income bound for Laurent p16 callers: with free scalar ADD/swap/even central powers/stage markers and paid odd shears (LOCAL, QUERY_SHEAR), the number of outputs that end as odd central monomials is at most the number of paid shears minus one; hence the controller's mass surplus per port (target ranks minus paid lifts minus thin requests) is at most the number of thick calls minus one, attained by the three retained p16 controllers (17 = 18 - 1).

author: Matarener
bottleneck_link: On the PR5907 word the complete rank-mass surplus is 760 = 104 x 17 - 18 x 56: 17 per port from the controller, 56 per full call lost in the owned centre. The bound says the 17 cannot grow with 18 thick calls; the surplus formula M = calls x (ports - centre) - ports then makes the centre and the fragmentation of the local word the only remaining complex-side levers (fragmentation-ceiling, PR5554).

open_questions.first_step: State the primitive as a physical job in research/p104-productive-controller/caller.py terms and extend the even-part tracker with its action; the bound becomes twisted <= sum over paid jobs of their even-rank change.
open_questions.question: Does the bound extend to callers whose paid primitives are not odd central shears of one pair, for example a paid rank-r Gaussian touching several banks or several ports at once?
open_questions.why_it_matters: Such a primitive could twist more than one output per paid job. It is one of the ways to raise the controller income above thick calls minus one; the others are a paid odd one-bank translation Q^{+-1} and a boundary that already carries odd Q content, while a paid job writing one row with a nonzero even self-coefficient obeys the bound for any number of source banks (independent audit, PR #6120, PROOF.md A4).

scope_change_reason: The card asks whether a changed query demand or caller can remove real work. The retained p16 controllers earn one unit of rank mass per output (the central Q axis enters each target for free) and pay one rank-one request per thin shear; a caller with the same 18 full calls but fewer thin shears, or more twisted outputs per shear, would raise the complete surplus. The even-part rank argument shows that no word in the controller alphabet can twist more outputs than paid shears minus one, so income minus thin requests never exceeds thick calls minus one. This closes the question for every caller graph in the alphabet, not only the path family of PR5405/PR5554.
stop_rule: Stop when the even-rank trace is 32,32,31,...,0 on all three retained controllers for two central-square values, all 32 declared outputs are odd monomials, the literal per-port income equals 17 = outputs - thin = thick - 1 on all three, and the controls (two-bank Whitehead word with three shears passes and its two-shear prefix fails; one thin shear fewer leaves a positive even rank; a free odd power is rejected) pass.
